FN005.name: Cancel Appointment
FN005.trigger: The patient clicks Cancel on an upcoming appointment in the mobile app.
FN005.description: The appointment is cancelled, its time slot is freed, and the deposit is refunded or forfeited according to how close the appointment is.
normal: The patient opens an upcoming appointment and selects Cancel.
The system shows the appointment and whether cancelling now is free or forfeits the deposit.
The system cancels the appointment, releases its time slot and refunds the deposit if cancelled at least 4 hours ahead.
The system shows the appointment as cancelled with its deposit status: refunded or forfeited.
abnormal: The appointment has already started or passed: the system rejects the cancellation and keeps the booking unchanged.
The appointment is less than 6 hours away: the system warns the patient that the deposit will be forfeited and asks for confirmation.
The deposit refund fails at the payment gateway: the system keeps the cancellation, queues the refund and tells the patient.
Another change already cancelled the appointment: the system shows it as cancelled and makes no further change.
The requester is not the patient who booked the appointment: the system refuses the cancellation and shows no appointment details.

validations.statement: An appointment must be selected before it can be cancelled.
An appointment can be cancelled free of charge only at least 4 hours before its start time.
A deposit is refunded when the appointment is cancelled in time and forfeited when cancelled later.

interactions.message: Reject cancellation as appointment already started
interactions.guard: appointment has already started or passed

interactions.message: Show deposit will be forfeited and ask for confirmation
interactions.guard: appointment is less than 6 hours away

interactions.message: Report refund queued after gateway failure
interactions.guard: deposit refund fails at payment gateway

interactions.message: Show cancelled appointment with deposit status

FN005.source_ref: User answer: cancel at least 4 hours before is free

FN006.name: Reschedule Appointment
FN006.trigger: The receptionist, at the branch front desk, opens an appointment and chooses Reschedule.
FN006.description: The appointment moves to a free slot of the same doctor and the old slot is released.
normal: The receptionist finds the patient's appointment and chooses Reschedule.
The system shows the free slots of the same doctor across all six branches.
The receptionist picks a new slot and confirms the change.
The system checks that the slot is still free and that the change is at least 4 hours before the original time.
The system moves the appointment to the new slot, releases the old slot and shows the updated time.
abnormal: The new slot was taken by another booking in the meantime: the system rejects the change and asks the receptionist to pick another slot.
The change is requested less than 6 hours before the original time: the system warns that the deposit is kept and moves the appointment only after the receptionist confirms.
The user has no update permission for the appointment: the Reschedule action is disabled and the appointment stays unchanged.
The appointment was already cancelled or completed: the system shows that it can no longer be changed and leaves it unchanged.
The 15-minute hold on the selected slot expires before confirmation: the system releases the slot and the receptionist must choose again.
The change notification to the patient fails: the appointment change is kept and the notification is retried from the queue.

validations.statement: A new slot must be selected before the change can be confirmed.
A doctor's slot cannot be double-booked across all six branches.
A change is free of charge only when made at least 4 hours before the original appointment time; a later change keeps the deposit.
A slot selected for a change is held for 15 minutes before it is released.

interactions.message: Show free slots of the doctor across all branches
Reject the change because the new slot is already taken
interactions.guard: new slot is taken by another booking

interactions.message: Warn that the deposit is kept
interactions.guard: change is less than 6 hours before the appointment
